recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Pickled Beets
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) can sliced beets, drained with liquid reserved

steps.text: Combine beet liquid, vinegar, sugar, cloves, cinnamon, and salt in a medium saucepan; stir to dissolve sugar, then bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium; simmer for 5 minutes. Add beets; simmer 5 minutes more.
Transfer beets to a clean jar using tongs; pour cooking liquid over beets to cover. Seal the jar; cool to room temperature. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Sweet and Sour Pickled Beets
raw_recipe.description: This sweet and sour beets recipe is easy to make with a can of sliced beets and a homemade pickling liquid flavored with whole cloves and ground cinnamon.

review.reviewBody: I used fresh beets instead of canned, just boiled them for about 10 minutes before continuing with recipe. Loved it!!

I had 3 medium sized fresh beets from a farmer's market down the street. As I Iove pickled beets so much, I decided to pickle them myself rather than just cook them as usual or buy the canned version. I peeled, thickly sliced and poached them in about 1.5 cups of water in a sauce pan. I removed the pieces with a slotted spoon, and to the sauce pan added to the hot beet juices the sugar, vinegar, 3 T squeezable ginger pulp (that has salt added to the mix) and a cinnamon stick to the pan, and proceeded with the directions. I did not add extra salt because the ginger pulp already had it. The only addition was ginger. I was out of ground cinnamon so used 1 stick in lieu of. 
After jarring and allowing to cool with the lid tight until it was room temperature, I transferred the jar to the fridge for 5 days. 

Myyyyyyyyyyyyy..... these were delicious, lightly spiced for January and they are simply beautiful atop my green salad with goat cheese and candied walnuts. 

I will be making more for a potluck next week. 

Thank you so much for the recipe!
Great. I used fresh beets roasted, 1/16 tsp ground cloves per whole clove, boiled mixture, added roasted pickles, and added enough fresh water to cover beets, and cooked about 10 more minutes.

Great simple recipe. I had a few large beets I cooked in the oven & started craving that pickled beet flavor. I just sliced them up and cooked them in the mixture for 5 minutes like it says and they are excellent. I added a little sliced onion & a bay leaf in the jar. Can't wait for them to chill!

Use beets from the Green Giant Veggie Spirals® selections, omit cloves, add onion powder, substitute sugar with Truvia baking blend (be aware of equivalent chart on back of bag). Mix cold beets with ingredients, let sit a few minutes and drain, then devour!

So EASY, so DELICIOUS!! I made the recipe before just as it was written and we loved it. I made it again recently, but w/ beets from our garden. I forgot about needing to save the beet broth from cooking them and couldn't as I didn't clean them fully before boiling. Having looked at other recipes that incl orange zest, I got the idea to use 1/2 c orange juice and a splash of water instead. They turned out wonderfully tangy sweet w/ the smell and gentle taste of the orange too. And they are so pretty. I'm giving little jars of them as Christmas gifts; no one will expect this of me so I can't wait!

I didn't have my Mother's recipe for red beet eggs, so I went looking and compared several different recipes. I followed this recipe except I used 1/4 teas. of ground cloves, 1/4 teas each of cinnemon and salt. My husband LOVES red beet eggs and he gave them a "5". This is a keeper!
Great recipe. Used different vinegars, and 5 beets pre cooked and sliced. The water was 4 cups after cooking. Cloves and cinnamon add to taste.
I Added a large thin sliced sweet onion and 2 garlic cloves to the mixture. Delicious.

I used malt and white vinegar mix, brown sugar and a few dashes of ground cloves (only because that’s what I had) and they are delicious. Thanks for the groundwork. Oh, and I had already steamed the fresh beets so this was to marinate in fridge.

These were delicious. I used fresh beets. I will make them again. Don't forget to remove the cloves before serving....I missed one and my brother-in-law got an unpleasant surprise. AFTER MAKING MANY MORE TIMES: I don't use whole cloves, I use about a tsp of powdered cloves. I am asked for this recipe over and over. I always use fresh beets.
thank you!
So easy. I’ve made it with fresh beets and canned when in a pinch. My kids can’t get enough.
It got a four because its not quite the recipe. I guess I like my s&s more sour, because I added another 1/4 cup of vinegar. Oh, and like all the others, I used fresh beets.
This is a great recipe! I used fresh beets from my garden and used the cooking liquid. Other than that, I followed the recipe exactly and they turned out really yummy.
I’ve made this tons of times. I use fresh beets. After I boil/cook them I save the water to add the ingredients to!! Delicious!!
excellent and easy

I’ve been using this recipe for some time now. They are like the ones my mother used to can and store in the cellar. This way I can make some whenever I am hungry for pickled beets and don’t have to make a big batch.
Yum, yum. So easy and so tasty. Thanks for sharing this recipe.

My husband said they tasted just like his grandmothers. I also used fresh beets and followed the receipt the 1st time, the second time I used less sugar. The longer they sit, the better they taste, but I encourage you to cut the beets as uniformly as possible for consistency, (or not!) either way, yummy.
